expectation: Membrane rings on activated/exhausted T cells, mostly a subset of CD4 cells, brightest on follicular helper T cells. Uncommon: clustered in the light zone of lymphoid follicles or aggregates and scattered in lamina propria; epithelium and muscle should be negative.
observed: A: haze over all tissue, glow and stripes off-tissue, debris dots, bright lines in muscle. B/C: diffuse haze, blobs, glow around a gland lumen. D: one blurred blob. E: faint lacy texture, green mostly beside CD4 cells, few white.
why: The signal follows tissue texture and autofluorescence, with no distinct ring-stained cells on the CD4 cells or in follicles.
notes: PD1 is diffuse haze with off-tissue glow, stripes and debris. In the CD4-rich field the faint lacy signal lies between CD4 cells rather than on a subset of them, and no clear PD1+ cell population is visible.
